declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval. Counsel exchanged proposals over three rounds. Our initial proposal paired a $32 million class fund with $6 million in court-approved fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $29 million fund and $5 million in fees; we proposed a $31 million fund on those remaining terms; Brightline then offered a $30 million fund, which we accepted. Every proposal provided for automatic payments to identified class members, no clear-sailing provision, and payment to the class of any fees the court declines to award. Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the first proposal, not only after agreement on class relief. The agreed $30 million fund is separate from the proposed fee award. The settlement provides substantial direct recovery without a claims process while avoiding certification risk, the risk of losing at trial, and an estimated two-to-three-year wait for trial. The $5 million fee remains subject to the court’s approval.
